title: Sand Marino | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Sand Marino is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Sand Marino is a newly updated 5-bedroom, 4-bath home located in the gated Villages of Blue Mountain Beach along Scenic 30A. Designed to comfortably accommodate up to 12 guests, this multi-level home offers a practical layout for families, multiple couples, or groups who want shared spaces for gathering along with private areas to unwind.Your SpaceThe main living area is located on the first floor and connects seamlessly to the kitchen, allowing guests to cook, socialize, and spend time together without feeling separated. The kitchen includes a peninsula with seating for four, while the adjacent dining area seats six, making meals and group gatherings easy and comfortable. This level works well as the central hub of the home, whether you’re starting the day or settling in after time out along 30A.Sunroom & Outdoor LivingLocated at the back of the home, the sunroom adds a bright and functional extension of the living space. Furnished with a table and chairs, it’s ideal for shared meals, card games, or quiet mornings with coffee. Many guests appreciate having this additional indoor-outdoor space for spending time together while still enjoying coastal breezes.Bedroom Layout & PrivacyA bedroom and full bathroom are conveniently located on the main level. Upstairs on the second floor, you’ll find three additional bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite and a bunk room that works especially well for kids or teens.The third floor serves as a private retreat, featuring a king bedroom with its own bathroom, seating area, and balcony—an ideal spot to wind down at the end of the day.Sleeping Arrangements* First FloorBedroom 1: Full bed, TV, shared hallway bathroom with tub/shower* Second FloorBedroom 2: King primary suite with private bathroom, dual vanities, jetted tub, and separate showerBedroom 3: King bed, TV, Jack-and-Jill bathroom, private balconyBedroom 4: Full-over-full bunk beds, TV* Third FloorBedroom 5: King bed, large TV, private bathroom, balcony accessBeach AccessHead out of the subdivision and turn right onto Highway 83. Continue down Highway 83, cross Scenic 30A, and follow the road to the Blue Mountain Beach access. This access offers parking, restrooms, and seasonal lifeguards.Distance: 0.5 miles | Time: Approximately 10 minutes walking or 3 minutes bikingVillages of Blue Mountain Beach AmenitiesThe gated Villages of Blue Mountain Beach community offers a secure and inviting atmosphere with a variety of amenities. Guests can enjoy the community swimming pool with a spacious sun deck, an on-site fitness center, and a shuffleboard court located near the pool area. Golf cart parking with dedicated electric outlets adds convenience for beach days.Guests have access to two nearby beach entry points: the public access at Highway 83 with parking and restrooms, and a private easement near Blue Lupine Condominiums at the end of Redfish Circle. Additional nearby beach options include Gulfview Heights and Grayton Beach State Park, located approximately four miles away.Exploring Blue Mountain Beach & Scenic 30ASand Marino is centrally located along Scenic 30A, putting you within biking or driving distance of local restaurants, coffee spots, and neighborhood shops. You can stop by the local creamery for fresh ice cream, explore charming bakeries and cafés, or enjoy the scenic walking and biking trails that wind through the area. Nearby spots like Redfish Taco, Blue Mountain Bakery, Blackbear Bakery, Cowgirl Kitchen, Redbar, Chiringo, AJ's at Grayton, Shunk Gulley, Pizza by the Sea, and Gulf Place Shopping Center each offer unique flavors, local vibes, and memorable experiences.A short drive west brings you to the dining, shopping, and entertainment options of Sandestin, Miramar Beach, and Destin. Heading east, you’ll find the quaint beach communities of Grayton Beach, Seagrove, Seaside, and other South Walton favorites, each offering its own coastal charm and opportunities to explore local culture.Your stay at Sand Marino comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Other things to know:* Weekly rentals only; Saturday to Saturday during Spring Break and Summer season.* Parking for 4 cars.* Sorry, no pets allowed.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
